summary: Full MVP testing completed for C.R.A.S.H. motorcycle safety app. Backend: 22/22 tests passed including auth, profile, contacts with verification tokens, impacts with AI diagnosis (Gemini), settings, and telemetry. Frontend: All screens functional with proper mobile UI, navigation working, contact creation with tokens working, profile/settings updates working. Impact simulation creates impacts successfully but list refresh timing needs attention.

integration_issues.issue: Impact simulation buttons work and create impacts successfully (verified in backend logs: POST /api/impacts 200 OK), but impacts don't appear in the list immediately after creation. The list fetch happens (GET /api/impacts 200 OK) but UI doesn't refresh to show new impact. User must manually refresh or navigate away and back.

action_items: Fix impact list refresh after simulation: After POST /api/impacts succeeds, the fetchImpacts() function is called but the UI doesn't update. Check if the state update in impacts.tsx is working correctly or if there's a race condition.
Consider adding a success toast/alert after impact simulation to confirm creation even if list doesn't refresh immediately
